summary: Created cards from the Oracle Proxy scans (issue 387): a general resolver (AbilityDefinition.Creates spec -> the published CreatedOnly scan that fits; CreatedCards.Resolve/Verify; ExecuteCreate for Personalities and attached Items/Followers/Spells; OncePerGame; created cards never left in a pile). Godot client not run locally (no Godot in this worktree); .jpg.import sidecars written to Godot's own format.
